claim: Residual kriging standard deviation represents only the kriged residual component under model assumptions; it is not automatically total predictive uncertainty or a calibrated prediction interval.
conditions: Applies to current RK_STD outputs unless trend-model, parameter, transformation and residual uncertainty are combined and externally calibrated.
limitations: Even nominal coverage can hide asymmetric or location-dependent miscalibration.
recommended_action: Label the layer residual kriging SD, validate uncertainty with coverage plus calibration/sharpness diagnostics, and only publish 90 or 95 percent intervals after calibration.
not_allowed_action: Do not label RK_STD a 90 percent or 95 percent prediction interval without a defined construction and validation.
